title: Tribal Dungeons of Global Shipping: AI Agents at Global Scale — Dmitry Buykin, Maersk
talk_summary: Maersk built a production agent system for global shipping exception handling around an executable SOP corpus, bounded runtime, and feedback capture rather than just an agent loop. It reports 200+ instances and 100k corrections over 9 months, with emphasis on traces, replay evals, guardrails, and composite tools.

takeaways.what_they_do: They translate tribal/legacy procedures into agent-executable SOPs with explicit preconditions, decisions, identifiers, backend calls, validation, recovery, and evidence, with experts owning the what and agents owning the how.
takeaways.evidence_quote: An agent SOP needs a more complex uh setup, preconditions, uh decisions, identifiers, back end calls, validation, recovery, and evidence of uh successful execution.

takeaways.technique: Replay real traces with writes disabled
takeaways.what_they_do: They evaluate quality by replaying real production examples with side effects disabled and checking whether behavior improved, rather than trusting vibes or a bigger model.
takeaways.evidence_quote: replaying real examples with u disabled rights to uh protect the production systems and checking whether behavior improved.

takeaways.what_they_do: They cluster failures, use traces as shared evidence, and require corrections to become executable changes rather than opinions or comments.
takeaways.evidence_quote: A correction only counts when it becomes an executable change.

takeaways.technique: Narrow function-calling tools over bloated MCP
takeaways.what_they_do: They avoid MCP servers as bloated, distill responses, and tune tools through function calling so agents get controlled, task-specific interfaces.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we're not using MCPS because uh for us it's uh always not the best choice. So because all all systems usually really bloated

takeaways.technique: Promote repeated sequences into composite tools
takeaways.what_they_do: They aggregate repeatable successful step sequences into bigger reusable tools that other agents can call across many countries.
takeaways.evidence_quote: aggregating all um repeatable sequences of steps successful scenarios and uh merging them into bigger tools

takeaways.what_they_do: They separate exploratory freedom from production execution and use harness guardrails to make unsafe or dumb paths impossible, with review/approval on critical paths.
takeaways.evidence_quote: The harness isn't there to give the agent more room. It's there to make the dumb mistakes impossible.
